verdict.rationale: IP India's own "Forms & Official Fees" page publishes the statutory First Schedule with fee amounts by filing mode and downloadable forms, rather than a contact form. That directly delivers the core of the story for patent filings. However, the evidence shows the actual amounts only on the patents fee page, so coverage of every transaction type is unproven. missing for 10: evidence of published fee amounts for trademark, design and GI transactions, verbatim fee figures or hands-on corroboration that the schedule matches specific transactions, and independent confirmation.

support.subject: As a founder, the exact statutory fees for my transaction are published on the service's own pages — amounts, not a contact form

citations.quote: Official fees are published as the statutory First Schedule with downloadable forms on the "Forms & Official Fees" page — amounts by filing mode, not a contact form.
